title: quercus mongolica var. liaotungensis
intro: Quercus mongolica var. liaotungensis, commonly known as Liaodong Oak, is a deciduous tree species within the Quercus genus. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Liaodong Oak involve antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids. The bioactive constituents of Liaodong Oak, particularly its flavonoids, have been studied for their potential therapeutic effects, including antiviral and anticancer properties.
